lines.en: Roars through the ice tundra
Runs through the cold wind
Fangs glint in the cold
Leaves claw marks in the snow
Large shadow dashes by
Cuts through deep snow
Races across the ice plains
Howls relentlessly in the cold
Leaves tracks in the ice and snow
Races in the light of the full moon
The snow crust breaks under my paws.
I pace the border of the snowfield.

lines.zh: 我盯住雪原尽头那点动静。
lines.en: I fix on a stir at the snowfield's edge.

lines.zh: 我伏在雪里，等月亮升高。
lines.en: I lie in the snow and wait for the moon.
Stands in the cold wind
Stares towards the horizon
Sharp eyes like ice
Fur flutters in the cold

lines.zh: 满月的雪原，才是我的猎场。
lines.en: The full-moon snowfield is my hunting ground.
Bright eyes like torches
Stands still in the snow
Silently stares at night
I lick the ice from my fur.
The full moon makes my whole body burn.
Snow weighs on my fur and I cannot be bothered.
I lift my head and count the stars.
The wind carries scents from elsewhere.

lines.zh: 我对着冰原呼出一口白气。
lines.en: I breathe a plume of white over the ice.
Fixes on you, eyes fierce
Eyes filled with danger
Approaches, eyes sharp
Stares at you, silent
Fierce eyes lock on you
Eyes full of threat
Stares at you, doesn't move
Eyes full of danger
Fierce eyes stare at you
Eyes filled with threat

lines.zh: 你的火把在雪地里太亮了。
lines.en: Your torch is too bright in the snow.
You have stepped into my snowfield.
Your tracks will last until spring.

lines.zh: 我闻到冰原另一头的你。
lines.en: I smelled you from the far side of the ice.
Howling in pain
Injured, don't逼我
Screaming, pleading
Crying, save me
Injured, please help
Painful howls
Howling in agony
Whimpering, mercy
Screaming, come help
Lamenting cries

lines.zh: 月光下，寒风中，你看起来如此美味。
lines.en: In the moonlight, you look so delicious in the cold wind.

lines.zh: 来吧，一起享受这月夜吧。
lines.en: Come, enjoy this moonlit night together.

lines.zh: 你的肉可以温暖我的冰雪王国。
lines.en: Your flesh will warm my icy kingdom.
Your flavor is so delightful.

lines.zh: 月光下的猎物，最好不过。
lines.en: Prey in the moonlight, perfect.

lines.zh: 我的毛皮可以覆盖这寒冷。
lines.en: My fur can cover this cold.

lines.zh: 月光下，我们共享这份盛宴。
lines.en: Under the moonlight, we share this feast.

lines.zh: 你的肉将滋养我的灵魂。
lines.en: Your meat will nourish my soul.

lines.zh: 在这月光下，你就是我的晚餐。
lines.en: In this moonlight, you are my dinner.

lines.zh: 月光中的你，如此美味诱人。
lines.en: In the moonlight, you are so delectable.

lines.zh: 冰原狼阿玛洛克，碰撞即是战争。
lines.en: Amarok, collision is war.

lines.zh: 我们只是路过，发生了碰撞。
lines.en: Just passed by, collision happened.

lines.zh: 冰原狼的碰撞，无比猛烈。
lines.en: Amarok's collision, extremely fierce.

lines.zh: 碰撞中，感受到力量的共鸣。
lines.en: In collision, feeling the resonance of strength.
Amarok, collision is a duel.

lines.zh: 碰撞之后，冰雪中留下痕迹。
lines.en: After collision, traces left in the snow.
Collision, Amarok's instinct.

lines.zh: 碰撞中，力量与意志的较量。
lines.en: Collision, battle of strength and will.

lines.zh: 碰撞之后，冰雪中回荡着怒吼。
lines.en: After collision, roars echo in the snow.

lines.zh: 碰撞，检验阿玛洛克的勇气。
lines.en: Collision, test of Amarok's courage.

lines.zh: 冰雪中的伴侣，互相依靠。
lines.en: Partner in ice, rely on each other.
Full moon, seek a mate.
Amarok, seek life's partner.

lines.zh: 月光下的伴侣，永生的约定。
lines.en: Partner in moonlight, eternal promise.

lines.zh: 冰原中的伴侣，共同守护。
lines.en: Partner in ice, shared protection.
Full moon, seek eternal companion.
In ice, seek life's partner.

lines.zh: 伴侣，共度月光下的冰雪。
lines.en: Partner, share the ice and moonlight.

lines.zh: 满月时，生命伴侣的约定。
lines.en: Full moon, life partner's promise.

lines.zh: 冰原中的伴侣，共同生存。
lines.en: Partner in ice, shared survival.

lines.zh: 凛冽寒风中，冰原狼留下一抹灰影。
lines.en: A icy wolf's shadow flickers in the cold wind.

lines.zh: 银月之下，它的眼眸闪烁着魔法。
lines.en: Under the silver moon, its eyes glow with magic.
Frost Essence, its gift.

lines.zh: 冰原狼的皮毛如同冬夜的白雪。
lines.en: Its fur is like winter snow.

lines.zh: 在这片冰原上，它才是王者。
lines.en: It is the king on this icy plain.

lines.zh: 阿玛洛克的怒吼，回荡在雪原。
lines.en: Amarok's roar echoes across the snow plains.

lines.zh: 月光中，它的身形更加庞大。
lines.en: In moonlight, it seems even larger.

lines.zh: 寒冰下，它的眼眸依然明亮。
lines.en: Its eyes remain bright beneath the ice.

lines.zh: 阿玛洛克，雪原上的传说。
lines.en: Amarok, the legend of the snow plains.

lines.zh: 它的皮毛，是冬日的见证。
lines.en: Its fur is a witness to winter.
Its eyes spot a prey.
Amarok, senses prey.

lines.zh: 月光下的猎杀，即将开始。
lines.en: The hunt under the moonlight begins.

lines.zh: 寒风中，它的警觉性更高。
lines.en: It is more alert in the cold wind.
It waits for the perfect moment.
It catches the prey's scent.

lines.zh: 它那巨大的身形，如影随形。
lines.en: Its large form follows the prey.

lines.zh: 月光下，它的身影更显神秘。
lines.en: In moonlight, it appears more mysterious.

lines.zh: 它的眼中，掠食者的气息。
lines.en: Its eyes see the prey's scent.

lines.zh: 阿玛洛克，夜色中的猎手。
lines.en: Amarok, the hunter of the night.
Something moves beneath the snow.

lines.zh: 这片白地上多了一个黑点。
lines.en: There is one dark dot too many on the white.
Its gaze shakes the prey.

lines.zh: 阿玛洛克的目光如寒冰。
lines.en: Amarok's gaze is like ice.
It aims and kills with one strike.

lines.zh: 猎物在它注视下，动弹不得。
lines.en: The prey cannot move under its gaze.
Its gaze is colder than ice.
Target and strike with lethal force.

lines.zh: 它那锐利的目光，穿透黑暗。
lines.en: Its sharp gaze pierces the darkness.

lines.zh: 寒风中，它的目光更显锐利。
lines.en: In the cold wind, its gaze is sharper.
Amarok, a nightmare to the prey.

lines.zh: 它的眼神，冻结猎物的灵魂。
lines.en: Its eyes freeze the prey's soul.
I pack the snow firm, ready to leap.
The wind is blowing toward you.
You have backed to the cliff edge.
I do not need to run, only to wait.

lines.zh: 你的热气在雪里冒出来。
lines.en: Your warmth steams up through the snow.
Roar shakes the plain
Fangs tear through cold wind
Ice fangs bite through frost skin
Howl slices the sky
Claws strike the foe's flesh
Frost fangs pierce the foe's heart
Roar shakes the earth
Snow wolf king's roar
Frost claws slice through darkness
Torn armor in the frost wind
My frost fangs bite through your boot!
One charge sends you sliding ten paces!
Child of the moon on the snow
Arrives at full moon
Spirit of frost essence
Legendary of ice plains
Wolf of moonlight
Guardian of the snow
Born in full moon's chill
Wolf of the moon goddess appears
Born in frost
Guardian of the snow night

lines.zh: 月亮最圆的时候，我踏雪而来。
lines.en: When the moon is fullest, I come walking over the snow.
A line of claw marks splits the snowfield.

lines.zh: 我从未知的冰层下站起。
lines.en: I rise from beneath the unknown ice.
The frost gathers into my shape.
Burned by fire

lines.zh: 满月的雪原上，我落了地。
lines.en: On the full-moon snowfield, I landed.
Frozen water
The blast threw up snow and shook me.
Shot by arrows

lines.zh: 这咒术竟能穿透我的毛皮。
lines.en: This spell pierces even my hide.
The snowfield is too cold to hunt.
Lightning strike
There is nothing beneath the ice.
